items.title: Transforming public sector AI adoption through IT-CNP’s Fusion Lab and AWS technologies
items.summary: Public sector agencies are rapidly adopting foundation models (FMs) and large language models (LLMs) to streamline operations, improve service delivery, and make data-driven decisions. From chat assistants assisting citizens to AI tools summarizing reports and automating approvals, these technologies are transforming public service delivery.
items.creator: Scheila Brambati
